name: @amical/swift-helper
description: Swift native helper for accessibility APIs and system integration

scripts.build:native: node -e "if (process.platform === 'darwin') { const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync('mkdir -p .build && swift build --configuration release && mkdir -p bin && cp .build/release/SwiftHelper bin/SwiftHelper', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { console.log('Skipping Swift helper build on non-macOS platform'); }"
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @amical/types generate:all && swift build --configuration debug && mkdir -p bin && cp .build/debug/SwiftHelper bin/SwiftHelper
